about.text: Lk Kitchen is a kitchen remodeler and countertop fabricator at 118 N Washington Ave in Dunellen, New Jersey. A linked Facebook page and several reviewers use the name Luxury Kitchen, and some call it Luxury Kitchen & Bath. The work centers on kitchens: helping customers choose a countertop, measuring and cutting it, installing it and upgrading the rest of the kitchen around it. The most recent Google reviews give five stars and describe a team that is reliable, punctual and focused on the small details that make a counter look right.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: Call or email to talk about your kitchen, your cabinets and the look you want, and go over countertop options.

steps.title: Measurements
steps.text: The team takes precise measurements of your cabinets and walls so the countertops fit cleanly once they are installed.

steps.title: Fabrication
steps.text: Your countertops are cut and finished to those measurements. Reviewers mention clean cuts and beautiful finishing on the edges.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: The installation crew sets the countertops and makes sure everything is properly aligned and finished before they leave your home.

service_area.text: Lk Kitchen is based at 118 N Washington Ave, Dunellen, NJ 08812. Dunellen is the town on its Google profile and the town tagged on its Facebook project photos. If you are planning new kitchen countertops or a kitchen upgrade in or near Dunellen, call (929) 374-9031 on a weekday to ask whether your home is in range and to set up a consultation.

items.q: Do you make the countertops yourselves?
items.a: Yes. Customers describe Lk Kitchen as a countertop fabricator and installer: the team handles the consultation, takes the measurements, fabricates the countertops and installs them. One reviewer said the whole process, from the first meeting through installation, was handled professionally and smoothly by the same team.

items.q: Can you help me pick a countertop?
items.a: Yes. Countertop selection is the most common topic in their Google reviews, and every job starts with a consultation. Bring photos of your cabinets, floors and any finishes you are keeping, and the team can help you compare options before anything is measured or cut.

items.q: Do you do more than countertops?
items.a: Yes. Lk Kitchen is listed on Google as a kitchen remodeler, and reviewers describe full kitchen upgrades. Bathroom remodeling is also listed on the business's social pages. Call to describe your project and the team can tell you how they would handle it.

Google lists Lk Kitchen as open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can call (929) 374-9031 during those hours or email luxurykitchen18@gmail.com at any time with photos and measurements of your kitchen.

items.q: How much will my countertops cost?
items.a: Price depends on the material you choose, the size of your kitchen, the edges and the cutouts for sinks and cooktops, so the team prices each job after measuring. A recent Google reviewer described their kitchen work as reasonably priced. Call or email to set up a consultation.
